title: @ycforge/pilot — cache manifest contract (spec 022)
description: Machine-readable contract for the incremental build cache manifest (spec 022, S-1, FR-001..004, FR-028). Cache lives under <projectRoot>/.ycsf/cache/manifest.json (version: 1). Compared via constants in src/cache/manifest.ts. Additive and non-breaking.

cacheEntry.title: CacheEntry
cacheEntry.description: One entry per app (last-build-wins, S-1). Hit iff effectiveFingerprint equals computed + blob valid (FR-010).

fingerprint.description: Own fingerprint: sha256(canonicalJson({ filesHash, buildConfig, buildEnv, builder })) — 64-char hex (S-2, FR-005).

effectiveFingerprint.description: Effective fingerprint: sha256(ownFingerprint + '|' + sortedJoin(depEffects)) — 64-char hex, blob key (S-2, FR-008, D-4).

artifactType.description: Artifact type of last build (e.g. "ycforge:function"), convention <package-scope>:<kind>.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful build for this app.

dependsOnFingerprints.description: Effective fingerprints of direct depends_on neighbours at build time (debug, S-1).

cacheReason.title: CacheReason
cacheReason.description: Per-app cache hit/miss reason for stderr and --json summary.cache.entries[].reason (S-6, FR-011, FR-023).

cacheCheckResult.title: CacheCheckResult
cacheCheckResult.description: Per-app cache result for observability and --json summary.cache.entries (S-6, FR-022..023).

hit.description: True = cache hit (skipped build), false = miss (built or failed).

fingerprint.description: Effective fingerprint (64-char hex) computed for this build.

blobPath.description: Absolute blob directory path; present only on hit.

cacheSummary.title: CacheSummary
cacheSummary.description: Aggregated cache stats for --json summary.cache (S-6, FR-023).

hits.description: Number of apps that were cache hits.

misses.description: Number of apps that were cache misses.

manifest.title: CacheManifest
manifest.description: Content of <projectRoot>/.ycsf/cache/manifest.json (S-1, FR-001, FR-004, FR-028). Lazily created on first successful build; absent = empty (no error).

version.description: Format version — must be 1 (Constitution III). Mismatch → CACHE_VERSION_MISMATCH warning + reset (all miss).

entries.description: Map appId → CacheEntry, last-build-wins per app (S-1).

blobLayout.title: CacheBlob layout
blobLayout.description: On-disk layout of .ycsf/cache/blobs/<effectiveFingerprint>/ (S-1, D-8, FR-003). Content-addressed by effectiveFingerprint.

blobsDir.description: Blob directory keyed by 64-char hex effectiveFingerprint.

artifactJson.description: File blobs/<fp>/artifact.json — Artifact { type, value } as returned by Builder.build().

files.description: Snapshot of builder's outputDir (recursive copy of .ycsf/artifacts/<appId>/) — files subtree inside blobs/<fp>/.

diagnostics.title: CACHE_* diagnostic code catalog
diagnostics.description: Cache warnings (FR-030, D-7). Emitted to stderr as warnings, NOT in --json diagnostics array; reason also in summary.cache.entries[].reason. Exit code stays 0 if build succeeded (fail-safe).

CACHE_CORRUPTED.description: Manifest is unparseable or I/O error on read (S-7, FR-025). Warning + treat as miss, self-heal on next successful build.

CACHE_BLOB_MISSING.description: Blob directory for cached fingerprint missing or lacks artifact.json/files (FR-013, S-3). Warning + miss + delete stale entry self-heal.

CACHE_WRITE_FAILED.description: I/O error on manifest/blob write (disk full, EACCES) (FR-026). Warning, build still exit 0 (artifacts in .ycsf/artifacts/ valid); next run miss.

CACHE_VERSION_MISMATCH.description: Manifest version !== 1 (FR-004). Warning + reset (treat all as miss, overwrite with version: 1 on next save).
